body:
C1 MINIMAL IMPLEMENTATION TOPOLOGY — READ-ONLY PROPOSAL, NOT AUTHORIZATION.

Based on the accepted current-main seam audit, C1 should be additive and confined to portable core plus law/test surfaces:

- core/sourcebundle.scala: bundle, edition, immutable stream manifests, derivation lineage, admitted semantic identity only; mutable access authorization remains outside the semantic object.
- core/axis.scala: presentation/native axis identities, signed coordinates, exact rational scale/origin/epoch/rendition/occurrence, nonempty AxisIntervalSet.
- core/mapping.scala: clock repair, track composition, edition correspondence; canonical relation identity distinct from derivation receipt; exact/quantized/enclosing/gap/outside/no-correspondence/ambiguous/refused outcomes.
- core/evidence.scala: heterogeneous nonempty EvidenceSupport with no generic mixed-axis hull/order/overlap.
- core/narrativeatlas.scala: checked proposal units and typed source support, without changing NarrativeCompilerInput yet.
- core/conformance.scala: additive text SurfaceAtlas and legacy TranscriptAtlas/AudioSpan conformance adapters.

C1 tests/laws own smart-constructor, mapping, occurrence, gap, exact-rational, overflow/refusal, D2 V8 mutation, text round-trip, and absent/nonempty/legacy-empty AudioSpan courts across JVM/JS/Native. Existing surface.scala and transcript.scala semantics remain byte/behavior compatible.

Explicit exclusions: no document compiler migration, StoryModel envelope, align source support, feature targets/tracks, ClaimMeta/Evidence migration, codecs, resolver change, worker, decoder, source read, or provider. Those are D0/D1 or later. C1 may prove an additive NarrativeSourceAtlas but cannot claim any existing scientific API consumes it.

File names are provisional; module and ownership boundaries are the proposal. AMEND later if an existing package law makes one placement wrong. This can become an implementation bead only after P1, aggregate B0, and exact landed D2 authority.
